topic: how to get a cash advance from chase credit card
slug: how to get a cash advance from chase credit card

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your Freedom Unlimited credit card on the home screen.
On the "Get a new PIN" screen, tap "Request PIN" if you don't have one. The PIN arrives by mail in 5 to 7 business days; to set your own PIN, visit a Chase branch.
Enter your 16-digit card number and tap "Request PIN".
Once your PIN arrives, visit any ATM that accepts Visa: insert your credit card, enter your PIN, choose "Cash advance" or "Credit", and enter the amount.
Expect a cash advance fee of $10 or 5% of the amount (whichever is greater), plus interest from day one. There's no grace period on cash advances.
